parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 99. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: SourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

*   **ECS_FILE**: Elastic Compute Service (ECS) files
*   **OSS**: Object Storage Service (OSS) buckets
*   **NAS**: File Storage NAS (NAS) file systems
*   **OTS**: Tablestore instances
*   **UDM_ECS**: ECS instances
*   **SYNC**: data synchronization

example.unifiedCli: aliyun hbr describe-backup-plans --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --source-type ECS_FILE --filters '[{"Values":["v-000000000000000000000"],"Key":"vaultId"}]' --edition STANDARD --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun hbr DescribeBackupPlans --region cn-hangzhou --Filters.1.Key vaultId --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --SourceType ECS_FILE --Filters.1.Values.1 'v-000000000000000000000' --Edition STANDARD
